phrases.text: If you want a garden fence, you start with a hole. Six hundred millimetres deep.
Drop in a little gravel, so the water drains, then stand the post up.
Pour in fast-setting concrete, and in minutes, it holds.
Add a gravel board, to keep the wood off the wet ground, then slide in a panel.
Repeat along the garden, and you have a fence.
Then next door's football comes over.
So you go higher. But the limit is two metres, so you add a net.
So you build a dome. Now nothing gets in. Including rain. Your lawn dies.
So you add sprinklers, and floodlights for the grass.
Now next door can see perfect grass under lights. So they bring a team.
So you add seats. Then more seats. Then a scoreboard.
Congratulations. You wanted a fence. You now own a stadium. And the ball still comes over.
